pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You are advising a large retail brand that runs a personalization engine for email, on-site recommendations, and paid retargeting — all fed by a shared user data platform. New privacy regulations in their top three markets are going to restrict third-party cookie tracking and limit the granularity of behavioral data they can collect without explicit consent. Walk me through how you would redesign their personalization architecture to maintain meaningful personalization performance under these constraints, and how you would reframe how the business measures the effectiveness of personalization when individual-level attribution is no longer reliable.
